plain: Deceitful; made in a secret deal to cheat a third party.

webster.text: Collusive; fraudulent; deceitful; as a covenous lease of lands.

example.quote: All Covenous or fraudulent Alienations or Conveyances of lands, tenements, or any heriditaments, shall be of no validitie to defeate any man from due debts or legacies, or from any just title, clame or possession, of that which is so fraudulently conveyed.
